title: 基于注意力网络的情感分析中的对比句处理

novelty_points.claim: 提出结合BERT与相对位置自注意力网络的方面级情感分析模型，通过动态加权采样和标签平衡改善对比句及中性样本的识别。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes aspect-level sentiment analysis combining BERT with relative-position self-attention, dynamic weighted sampling, and label balancing to improve contrastive-sentence and neutral-sample classification.
technical_features: 通过动态加权采样缓解对比句稀缺，使模型学习更多对比句特征。
双头自注意力提取带相对位置的特征，并与预训练模型的绝对位置特征联合训练。
通过标签平衡对模型进行正则化，稳定对中性样本的辨识。
technical_features_en: Uses dynamic weighted sampling to address scarce contrastive sentences and learn their features.
Jointly trains relative-position features from double-head self-attention with absolute-position features from the pretrained model.
Uses label balancing for regularization to stabilize neutral-sample identification.
